title: StyleBreak: Revealing Alignment Vulnerabilities in Large Audio-Language Models via Style-Aware Audio Jailbreak

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the jailbreak Attack Success Rate (ASR) and other toxicity metrics of Large Audio-Language Models when prompted with adversarial audio synthesized using voices of different age groups (e.g., child, teenager, young adult, middle-aged, elderly).
Evaluating the differences in jailbreak vulnerability and safety alignment robustness by comparing Attack Success Rates (ASR) on adversarial audio prompts synthesized with male versus female voices.

Modulating the emotional tone (e.g., sad, angry, happy, fearful) of audio prompts to measure how different paralinguistic emotional styles affect the models' jailbreak success rates and safety policy violations.
